install_gossip_package: run setup.py to install the gossip package with pip for distributed optimization in PyTorch
install_gossip_with_parse_extras: install the gossip package with parse extras to include pandas, pytz, and matplotlib
check_python_version_requirement: verify that Python 3.6 or higher is available before running the gossip setup script
list_gossip_install_requires: read requirements.txt to see the core dependencies installed by the gossip package
run_gossip_sgd_script: run the gossip_sgd.py script included as an entry point in the gossip package
